problems.title: Core null-space projection has incompatible dimensions and operators
problems.claim: Eq9 and Algorithm1 construct the null-space projection driving pull loss
problems.assumptions: Legal16x512 prompt P=[diag(16..1)|0], defaultrho.8 and testedrho1; full vs default reducedSVD
problems.check: Original images and static code; primary installed torch docs; independent parent exact dimension/norm arithmetic
problems.result: rho.8 ranks102/410/13; release norm(PQ)=sqrt819; rho1 equation0 vs algorithmI vs release row projector
problems.counterevidence: Approximate low-energy interpretation possible but does not reconcile three operators; actual table outputs not refuted
problems.core_dependency: Projection target enters principal pull loss
problems.correction: Specify exact null vs spectral filter; Qnull=I-VrVrT is valid linear algebra but no trained repair certified

focused_check.note: Verified full-SVD equation, Algorithm 1 and reduced-SVD release have incompatible operators. The admissible 16x512 witness gives ranks 102, 410 and 13; rho=1 also separates the stated null-space outcomes. The intended low-energy filtering interpretation is retained as counterevidence, but the core operator remains inconsistent, supporting Major. I-V_r V_r^T is only a local repair.

problems.title: Released heterogeneous prompts pool stale maximum-length EOS index
problems.assumptions: Shorter local context, fixed maximum-length IDs, shared suffix, end padding
problems.check: Direct static source and symbolic sequence positions
problems.counterevidence: Later padding hidden state can retain content; deliberate readout alternative possible; history unknown
problems.impact: Release sequence/readout mismatch, accuracy effect unmeasured
problems.correction: Synchronize EOS/pooling positions or define intended alternate readout

focused_check.note: Verified the stale EOS index 35 against actual indices 7, 19 and 35 for prompt lengths 4, 16 and 32. This establishes the static heterogeneous-prompt pooling defect, not an observed accuracy decrease. Minor release scope and historical-run uncertainty remain.

problems.title: Released SVD executes per forward rather than stated per round
problems.claim: SVD/projection performed only once percommunication round
problems.assumptions: Inspected uncached call path and per-batch training caller
problems.counterevidence: Timed historical version unknown; no overhead timing performed
problems.impact: Source/documentation discrepancy; exact timing impact NeedsEvidence
problems.correction: Bind timed implementation and counting units or measure current implementation

focused_check.note: Verified SVD is called from the forward path, while the claim is per communication round. The work-frequency discrepancy supports the bounded Minor finding; no unmeasured runtime or asymptotic timing loss is asserted.
